title: A Low-Cost IoT Device for Environmental Monitoring and Embedded Solar Forecasting with On-Device Incremental Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.14698v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Hyperlocal meteorological sensing is essential for accurate solar photovoltaic forecasting, yet professional-grade meteorological stations require investments easily exceeding 1000~USD per node, making distributed deployments economically inaccessible. This work presents a modular internet of things (IoT) device based on the ESP32 microcontroller integrating temperature, humidity, luminosity, and solar irradiance sensors in an IP68-rated enclosure at a total hardware costs of about \$65~USD when components are sourced in Germany. A hybrid architecture decouples external model training, performed on a conventional computer using the software Python and the open-source library TensorFlow, from autonomous 24-hour solar voltage forecasting executed on-device via a three-layer feedforward network with 3{,}011 parameters (11.8\,KB). The network is trained offline on site-collected data and deployed on the microcontroller as static weight mat

translated_title: 一种低成本物联网设备，用于环境监测和嵌入式太阳预测，支持设备端增量学习
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14698v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：超本地气象传感对于准确的太阳能光伏预测至关重要，然而专业级气象站每节点的投资轻易超过1000美元，使得分布式部署在经济上不可行。本工作提出了一种基于ESP32微控制器的模块化物联网（IoT）设备，集成了温度、湿度、光照度和太阳辐照度传感器，并采用IP68防护等级的外壳，在德国采购组件时总硬件成本约为65美元。一种混合架构将外部模型训练（在传统计算机上使用Python软件和开源库TensorFlow进行）与设备端自主24小时太阳能电压预测解耦，后者通过一个具有3,011个参数（11.8 KB）的三层前馈网络在设备上执行。该网络在采集的现场数据上离线训练，并作为静态权重矩阵部署在微控制器上。
tldr: 本文介绍了一种成本约65美元的ESP32物联网设备，集成了气象传感器和轻量级神经网络，实现了低成本的分布式太阳能预测。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a low-cost IoT device based on ESP32 with integrated meteorological sensors and a lightweight neural network, enabling affordable distributed solar forecasting.
